sent_prompt: /corpflow:request-plan "CHANGELOG.md is 183KB and unreadable. what's the plan to split it?"
response:
# Plan: Split CHANGELOG.md into per-release files under a size budget

## Context
`CHANGELOG.md` is 2,165 lines / 183KB, Keep a Changelog format, 34 version headers (`3.35.0` → `4.0.17`, plus `Unreleased`) — entries have grown verbose (the `[Unreleased]` section alone documents a single fix in 9 lines). It's referenced from `README.md` ("release history"), `tests/README.md` (a fix disclosure link), and `skills/cross-plugin-handoff/references/plugin-contract.md` (version-bump/release-notes contract row) — any split has to keep those links resolvable. `4.0.x` alone accounts for ~18 of the 34 entries, so a flat by-major-minor split is uneven; by-major (`3.x` vs `4.x`) is more balanced.

## Goal
`CHANGELOG.md` stays small enough to read in one shot (current + a couple recent releases), with older history moved to dated archive file(s), and every existing inbound reference still resolves.

## Scope
**In:** archive old release entries out of the root file, keep `[Unreleased]` + the most recent N releases in `CHANGELOG.md`, add a link from `CHANGELOG.md` to the archive(s), fix the two doc references that assume everything lives in one file.
**Out:** changing the changelog *format* (Keep a Changelog stays), automating changelog generation, or touching the release-engineering tooling that appends new entries — cite `corpflow:release-engineering` skill separately if that's wanted next.

## Phases
| Phase | Scope | Why this order |
|-------|-------|----------------|
| P0 — Required | Split at a version boundary (e.g. keep `4.0.x` + `Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md`, move `3.x` into `CHANGELOG-3.x.md` or `docs/changelog-archive/`); add a "full history" link at the bottom of the trimmed file | Delivers the actual readability fix; one clean cut is lower-risk than a multi-file scheme |
| P1 — Nice-to-have | Update the two cross-references (`tests/README.md` disclosure link, `plugin-contract.md` row) to note the archive split | Keeps existing docs accurate, but nothing breaks if deferred a cycle |
| P2 — v1.1 | Per-major-version archive files (`CHANGELOG-3.x.md`, future `CHANGELOG-5.x.md`) instead of one big archive, if `4.x` alone regrows past budget | Only worth doing once there's evidence one archive file is itself getting unwieldy |

## Effort (rough)
| Size | Complexity (0–25) | Notes |
|------|-------------------|-------|
| XS–S | 3–5 | Mechanical file split + two doc-link edits; no code or test surface touched |

## Risks & Dependencies
- **Broken links**: `README.md`, `tests/README.md`, and `plugin-contract.md` all point at `CHANGELOG.md` directly — mitigate by grepping for `CHANGELOG.md` repo-wide after the split (already confirmed: 3 non-CHANGELOG files reference it) and updating any that assume full history is inline.
- **Release tooling assumptions**: if any script appends to `CHANGELOG.md` expecting it to be the sole/growing file (not found in this repo, but worth a final grep before executing), the split needs to preserve that append point.
- No security-sensitive surface — pure docs/file reorganization.

## Recommended next step
`/worktask "split CHANGELOG.md into a trimmed current file plus an archived-history file, keeping all existing doc references valid"` — XS/S-sized, no security surface, so PL0 dynamic sizing will run this as a lightweight (likely single-stage) pipeline.
